users.description: Root identity table. All portal logins start here.

patients.description: Patient profile. Optionally linked to a users account for portal login.

hospital_staff.description: Links a users account to a hospital with role and department.

cms_users.description: Links a users account to a payer organization with a CMS role.

patient_data_records.description: OMOP-aligned EHR import table. 34 columns per visit. Primary ML model input.

patient_conditions.description: Active and historical diagnoses per patient.

patient_medications.description: Medication history with optional OMOP/RxNorm code.

patient_allergies.description: Allergen, reaction, and severity per patient.

patient_preferences.description: AI consent, data sharing, and communication preferences. One row per patient.

patient_activity_log.description: Full audit trail of all patient-facing events.

assessments.description: A triage session. Captures what the patient reports at submission time.

assessment_symptoms.description: Each additional symptom selected during an assessment.

assessment_safety_questions.description: Boolean safety screening questions answered during triage. Read by the ESI safety gate.

assessment_medical_context.description: Confirmed medical history key-value pairs for this assessment session.

care_recommendations.description: AI/rules engine output — the triage decision with full explanation.

care_plans.description: Active care roadmap tying patient + assessment + recommendation together.

care_plan_actions.description: Step-by-step actionable tasks within a care plan.

care_plan_providers.description: Providers recommended or assigned to a care plan.

daily_goals.description: Daily patient checkbox goals generated from a care plan.

safety_protocols.description: Emergency warning triggers attached to a care plan.

providers.description: Care providers with geolocation for facility matching.

healthcare_encounters.description: Visit history — ED, inpatient, outpatient per patient.

lab_results.description: Clinical lab values per patient per date.

medical_files.description: Uploaded clinical document metadata. Actual bytes stored on disk in uploads/.

file_ai_summaries.description: AI-generated overview and key findings for each medical file.

claims.description: Insurance claims with billing amounts and ICD/CPT codes.

hos_ed_trends.description: Daily ED total vs avoidable visits chart data.

hos_request_volume.description: Daily care request volume chart data.

hos_avoidable_diagnoses.description: ICD code breakdown of avoidable diagnoses.

hos_care_requests.description: Authorization request queue with AI assessment JSON.

cms_metric_trends.description: Weekly ED and repeat visit trend data.

cms_engagement_trends.description: Quarterly ED vs PCP visit engagement data.

cms_member_risks.description: Risk-stratified member list for population health management.
